title: Social Media Marketing Manager
description:
Company: Drive Core Auto Parts
  
📍 Location: Meerut, Uttar Pradesh
  
🌎 Market: United States
  
💼 Employment Type: Full-Time
  
💰 Compensation: Competitive / Market Standards + Uncapped Performance Incentives
  
About Drive Core Auto Parts
  
Drive Core Auto Parts is a U.S.-focused automotive parts business serving customers across the United States.
  
We’re looking for a creative, analytical and results-driven Social Media & Performance Marketing Manager who can take ownership of our digital presence and help us build a strong, recognizable automotive brand in the U.S. market.
  
This is not a role for someone who simply schedules posts.
  
We’re looking for someone who understands content, paid advertising, organic growth, lead generation, audience building and performance marketing — and knows how to turn digital attention into real business results.
  
🚀 What You’ll Do
  
• Develop and execute a complete social media and digital marketing strategy for the U.S. market
  
• Manage and grow our presence across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), YouTube and other relevant platforms
  
• Manage Meta Business Suite / Meta Ads, including campaign creation, audience targeting, retargeting, optimization and performance analysis
  
• Plan, launch and optimize Google Ads campaigns, including Search, Display, Performance Max and remarketing
  
• Create engaging Reels, TikToks, Shorts, graphics, posts, carousels and other short-form content
  
• Develop content strategies specifically designed to attract and engage U.S. automotive customers
  
• Drive qualified traffic, leads, enquiries and ultimately customers through organic and paid channels
  
• Manage and improve our presence across Google, Yelp, BBB and other relevant business/review platforms
  
• Build and strengthen Drive Core Auto Parts' presence on LinkedIn, including company content and B2B outreach opportunities
  
• Identify trends, viral opportunities, automotive communities, influencers and potential partnerships that can increase brand visibility
  
• Use analytics and performance data to continuously improve campaigns and content
  
• Track important metrics including CTR, CPC, CPM, CPL, CPA, conversion rate, engagement, traffic and ROAS
  
• Leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Canva AI and other emerging tools to accelerate content creation, research, campaign development and marketing execution
  
• Continuously experiment with new platforms, content formats, advertising strategies and growth opportunities
  
🎯 What We’re Looking For
  
Must Have:
  
✅ Hands-on experience with Meta Business Suite / Meta Business Manager
  
✅ Practical experience managing Meta Ads
  
✅ Intermediate to advanced understanding of Google Ads
  
✅ Strong understanding of Instagram and Facebook marketing
  
✅ Understanding of TikTok and short-form video marketing
  
✅ Strong content creation and copywriting skills
  
✅ Understanding of digital marketing analytics and performance metrics
  
✅ Ability to independently develop and execute marketing campaigns
  
✅ Strong English communication skills
  
✅ Ability to understand and market to a U.S. audience
  
✅ Comfortable using AI tools as part of your everyday marketing workflow
  
⭐ You'll Have An Advantage If You Have:
  
• Automotive / auto-parts industry experience
  
• Experience marketing to customers in the United States
  
• Google Analytics / GA4 knowledge
  
• SEO experience
  
• WordPress / Shopify / e-commerce experience
  
• Canva, Photoshop or graphic-design skills
  
• Video editing experience
  
• Influencer / creator marketing experience
  
• Lead-generation experience
  
• Proven experience generating measurable ROI/ROAS from digital campaigns
  
🔥 Who We’re Looking For
  
We want someone who doesn't wait to be told what to post.
  
We want someone who can look at a business, understand its customers, identify opportunities and say:
  
“Here’s what we should do, here’s why it will work, and here’s how we’ll measure it.”
  
If you're creative but also analytical, understand both organic and paid marketing, love experimenting with new platforms, and want to build something rather than simply manage a social-media calendar — we want to hear from you.
  
💼 What We Offer
  
💰 Competitive market-standard compensation
  
📈 Uncapped performance-based incentives
  
🌎 Opportunity to work on the U.S. market
  
🤖 Freedom to leverage modern AI & marketing technologies
  
🚀 Opportunity to directly contribute to the growth of an expanding automotive business
  
📊 Performance-driven work environment
  
🏆 Growth opportunities for the right candidate
  
On-site position in Meerut. Exceptional candidates with the right experience and proven results may also be considered for alternative working arrangements.
  
📩 How To Apply
  
Send us your CV/Resume + portfolio + examples of social-media accounts, campaigns or marketing projects you have managed.
  
If you have real results to show, we want to see them.
  
Think you can help take Drive Core Auto Parts to the next level?
  
Apply now. 🚗🔥

title: Sales and Marketing Executive
description:
ABCD is a rapidly growing organization specializing in psychology and personal development. The company offers a range of courses, counseling, and training programs designed to support individual growth and mental well-being. ABCD focuses on delivering high-quality, evidence-based content and services to diverse learners and clients. Team members collaborate in a mission-driven environment that values continuous learning and innovation.

**Role Description**
The Sales Marketing Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Gautam Buddha Nagar. This position is responsible for developing and implementing sales and marketing strategies to promote ABCD’s courses, counseling, and training services. Day-to-day tasks include planning and executing campaigns, managing digital and offline marketing initiatives, generating and nurturing leads, and coordinating with the counseling and training teams to align offerings with market needs. The role involves tracking performance metrics, preparing reports, optimizing marketing activities based on data, and building relationships with partners, institutions, and clients. The Sales Marketing Manager will also support brand positioning, oversee marketing materials, and contribute to market research and competitor analysis.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated skills in sales planning, lead generation, and relationship management.
* Experience with marketing strategy, campaign planning, and brand development.
* Proficiency in digital marketing tools and channels, such as social media, email marketing, and basic analytics.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to analyze market trends, customer needs, and performance data to inform decisions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Psychology, or a related field; advanced qualifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience in education, training, or psychology-related services is preferred but not mandatory.
* Capacity to work collaboratively on-site, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Salary between 20000 to 30000 depends upon experience including incentives

title: Parts Sales Administration, Pricing & Marketing
description:
**About Us**
 Innovation. Sustainability. Productivity. This is how we are Breaking New Ground in our mission to sustainably advance the noble work of farmers and builders everywhere. With a growing global population and increased demands on resources, our products are instrumental to feeding and sheltering the world.
   

  

 From developing products that run on alternative power to productivity\-enhancing precision tech, we are delivering solutions that benefit people – and they are possible thanks to people like you. If the opportunity to build your skills as part of a collaborative, global team excites you, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Grow a Career. Build a Future!**
 Be part of this company at the forefront of agriculture and construction, that passionately innovates to drive customer efficiency and success. And we know innovation can’t happen without collaboration. So, everything we do at CNH Industrial is about reaching new heights as one team, always delivering for the good of our customers.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
* The Candidate will be responsible for administrating Parts and Lubricants sales growth through close coordination with sales team
* The role involves developing and executing sales strategies, business planning, target management, pricing, marketing initiatives, and sales analytics to maximize aftermarket revenue and profitability.
* The candidate should have strong experience in the tractor, agricultural equipment, automotive, construction equipment, or similar OEM industry, with proven expertise in aftermarket business management


**Key Responsibilities**
**Sales Budgeting \& Forecasting**
* Develop annual and quarterly Parts \& Lubricants sales targets in line with organizational objectives
* Develop monthly sales forecasts and monitor budget achievement.
* Analyze sales trends and recommend corrective actions for achieving business targets.
* Ensure profitability targets are achieved through proper product mix and pricing strategies. Support new product launches and aftermarket business expansion initiatives.


**Pricing \& Profitability Management**
* Develop and maintain competitive pricing strategies.
* Conduct market benchmarking and competitor price analysis.
* Recommend pricing revisions based on market conditions and profitability objectives.
* Monitor discount structures and dealer margins.
* Coordinate with Purchasing to identify Cost Reduction opportunities \& monitor Commodity movements


**Marketing \& Business Development**
* Plan and execute aftermarket marketing campaigns.
* Coordinate dealer promotions, service camps, loyalty programs, and seasonal campaigns.
* Develop strategies for increasing genuine parts and lubricant consumption.
* Support digital marketing initiatives and customer engagement programs.


**Sales \& Parts Data Analysis**
* Generate MIS reports and dashboards for management review.
* Provide business insights using Excel, Power BI, ERP, and CRM systems.
* Track Sales for different categories of parts and recommend promotional actions


**Customer \& Market Intelligence**
* Conduct market research and competitor analysis.
* Gather customer feedback and identify improvement opportunities.
* Monitor industry trends related to tractors, farm equipment, lubricants, and aftermarket business.


**Experience Required**
* 8–15 years Manager Level in:
+ Tractor OEM
+ Agricultural Equipment
+ Automotive Aftermarket
+ Construction Equipment
+ Commercial Vehicles
+ Lubricants Industry


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Agriculture, Business Administration.
* MBA (Marketing / Sales / Operations) preferred.


**Pay Transparency**
 The annual salary for this role is INR ₹2,000,000\.00 \- ₹2,200,000\.00 plus any applicable bonus (Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as skill, experience and qualification for the role.)
   

  

 For roles open across multiple locations, the salary range indicated refers to the primary location. If a different location is considered, the applicable salary range will be communicated to candidates prior to the first interview.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 We offer dynamic career opportunities across an international landscape. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to delivering value for all our employees and fostering a culture of respect.
   

  

**Benefits**
 At CNH, we understand that the best solutions come from the diverse experiences and skills of our people. Here, you will be empowered to grow your career, to follow your passion, and help build a better future. To support our employees, we offer regional comprehensive benefits, including:
   

  

* Flexible work arrangements
* Savings \& Retirement benefits
* Tuition reimbursement
* Parental leave
* Adoption assistance
* Fertility \& Family building support
* Employee Assistance Programs
* Charitable contribution matching and Volunteer Time Off

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION** 




**MARKETING MANAGER – PIPES, FITTINGS, SPOOLS \& SKIDS** 




**Company** 




 Kisaan Techno Forge Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Location** 




 Sikandrabad, Uttar Pradesh
 



**Department** 




 Marketing \& Business Development
 



**Reports to** 




 Director / Managing Director
 



**Employment** 




 Full\-time
 



**Experience** 




 5\+ years relevant experience
 



**Business Scope** 




 Domestic \& Export
 



**Products** 




 Pipes • Fittings • Spools • Skids
 


 1\. POSITION PURPOSE
 
 Lead business development and sales for pipes, fittings, fabricated piping spools and skids; build a strong customer/project pipeline; secure profitable orders; and ensure disciplined coordination from enquiry through payment collection and customer satisfaction.
 


 2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 
**•** 
 Develop and execute annual/quarterly sales and business\-development plans for domestic and export markets.
 



**•** 
 Identify and develop EPCs, OEMs, consultants, project owners, industrial customers, institutional buyers and approved\-vendor opportunities.
 



**•** 
 Generate enquiries through customer visits, references, tenders, exhibitions, industry networks and digital channels; maintain a live CRM/sales pipeline.
 



**•** 
 Understand drawings, specifications, scope of supply, materials, applicable codes/standards, inspection requirements and delivery expectations.
 



**•** 
 Coordinate techno\-commercial quotations, costing, margins, payment terms, delivery schedules, clarifications, negotiations and order finalisation.
 



**•** 
 Drive enquiry\-to\-order conversion, order booking, revenue, contribution margin and collections; protect commercial discipline.
 



**•** 
 Track projects and market intelligence: demand, pricing, competitors, upcoming projects and customer/vendor\-registration requirements.
 



**•** 
 Coordinate with Engineering, Estimation, Production, Planning, Purchase, Quality, Dispatch and Finance to ensure realistic commitments and timely execution.
 



**•** 
 Support contract review, pre\-order meetings, customer documentation, complaint resolution and recovery of overdue payments.
 



**•** 
 Develop repeat business and strategic/key\-account relationships; represent the company at customer meetings, exhibitions, conferences and vendor meets.
 



**•** 
 Lead/mentor the marketing team, set measurable targets, review performance and ensure systematic enquiry, quotation, order and customer\-feedback tracking.
 


 3\. TARGET MARKETS / CUSTOMER SEGMENTS
 
 Oil \& Gas • Petrochemicals • Chemicals • Power • Water Treatment • Pharmaceuticals • Infrastructure • Process Equipment • EPC Projects • Engineering \& Manufacturing • OEMs and Industrial Buyers.
 


 4\. KEY DELIVERABLES / KPIs
 
**•** 
 Sales \& order booking versus target; revenue and contribution margin.
 



**•** 
 Qualified pipeline value/coverage, enquiry\-to\-order conversion and quotation turnaround.
 



**•** 
 New customers/accounts, repeat orders and customer retention.
 



**•** 
 Domestic/export business growth and project/customer penetration.
 



**•** 
 On\-time commercial follow\-up, order execution coordination and collection/DSO performance.
 



**•** 
 Customer satisfaction, complaint closure and accuracy/timeliness of management reporting.
 


 5\. QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE
 
**•** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing or related discipline; B.E./B.Tech (Mechanical/Production/Industrial) preferred.
 



**•** 
 MBA in Marketing/Business Development is desirable.
 



**•** 
 Minimum 5 years’ relevant B2B industrial marketing/sales/business\-development experience; experience in pipes, fittings, piping fabrication, spools, skids, process equipment or engineering products preferred.
 



**•** 
 Exposure to EPC/OEM/consultant/project procurement, vendor registration, pre\-qualification and tendering is desirable.
 



**•** 
 Established industry/customer network and experience with major engineering organisations are an advantage.
 


 6\. TECHNICAL / COMMERCIAL KNOWLEDGE
 
**•** 
 Working knowledge of piping products, fabrication, welding, machining, inspection/testing, drawings, BOM and scope of supply.
 



**•** 
 Understanding of materials, applicable national/international codes, QAP/ITP and customer documentation.
 



**•** 
 Ability to assess costing, margins, commercial terms, delivery, technical/commercial risks and contract requirements.
 



**•** 
 Awareness of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 systems and disciplined documentation.
 


 7\. CORE COMPETENCIES
 
**•** 
 Business development, consultative selling, negotiation and closing.
 



**•** 
 Strong communication, presentation, networking and relationship management in English and Hindi.
 



**•** 
 Commercial acumen, market intelligence, forecasting, data analysis and CRM discipline.
 



**•** 
 Cross\-functional coordination, problem solving, ownership and team leadership.
 



**•** 
 High integrity, confidentiality, professional maturity and customer focus.
 



**•** 
 Result orientation with SMART commitments and strong follow\-up discipline; willing to travel extensively as required.
 


 8\. MANAGEMENT REPORTING
 
 Provide periodic MIS covering enquiry funnel, quotations, order booking, pipeline, sales forecast, customer visits, market intelligence, order status, collections, risks and corrective actions.
 


 9\. APPLICATION INFORMATION
 
 Candidates should submit an updated résumé with current/expected compensation, notice period, relevant industry experience, key customers/markets handled, major business achievements and willingness to travel.
